p06.title: The problems
p06.runs: The same prompt does not give the same result.
p06.runs.source: The same task can vary 30-fold in tokens. Bai et al., 2026
p06.cost: An agent can do this. That does not mean it must.
p06.cost.source: One issue: 17 minutes and 2.4M tokens, twice, with no result.
p06.human: Human attention is the thing that runs out.
p06.human.source: Top reason agent pull requests fail: nobody reviewed them (38%). Ehsani et al., MSR 2026
